checkpoint_selection.reason: Both runs were incomplete and both contained the same epoch-140 checkpoint.

method.action_sampling_seed: 20260925 + realization_seed; same per realization across checkpoints
method.mask_and_candidate_enumeration: Current formal Cache trigger mask and enumerate_cache_target_configurations through _node_policy_state.
method.branch_execution: Current _execute_cache_branch -> build_policy_target_configuration -> execute_slot; other Cache heads, both UAV decisions, task, prediction, and vehicle state are held to the realized transition.
method.critic_bootstrap: Frozen checkpoint critic on each branch next observation; gamma from checkpoint run config.
method.current_tdq: Current compute_one_step_tdq_cache_trigger_credit output; oriented UPDATE-minus-KEEP by the specified actual-action rule.
method.raw_tdq_std_definition: Population standard deviation (ddof=0). Normalized mean magnitude is mean(abs(raw_tdq / GLOBAL_TDQ_STD)).
method.head_imbalance_rule: Observed if largest/smallest nonzero head mean absolute normalized TD-Q is at least 2.0 for either checkpoint.
method.reference_asymmetry_rule: Per checkpoint YES at mismatch rate >=0.50, NO at <=0.10, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; requires at least 30 sign-comparable observations. Overall YES/NO only if both checkpoints agree.
method.reference_fix_rule: YES only if both checkpoints support asymmetry, NO only if both reject it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
